# Fix Customer Service — Abdullah Khan

> One-person customer service operations practice in Dubai, UAE, working with businesses worldwide. Abdullah Khan has spent thirteen years in customer service, the last seven building and running the function at a fintech in Dubai, and now helps businesses fix their support: faster replies, lower cost per contact, fewer repeat questions, better reviews, and a team setup that scales without linear hiring.

Engagements run in three stages, and a client can stop after any of them: a free 30-minute diagnostic call that names the three biggest problems honestly; a one-week "look" that counts incoming messages, response times, missed enquiries and cost; and a fixed-price "fix" covering shared inbox setup, automated answers to repeat questions, reply-time targets, complaint handling, team structure and training. Optional monthly follow-up adds reporting, quality checks and tuning.

For businesses of any size and industry, from a few hundred to hundreds of thousands of customer messages a month. Based in Dubai, working remotely across the UAE and internationally.

## Pages

- [Fix Customer Service](https://fixcustomerservice.com/): Single-page site covering the symptoms of broken support, what it costs, how the work runs, past results, and how to get in touch.
- [Privacy](https://fixcustomerservice.com/privacy): What data the contact form collects and how it is handled.

## Key sections

- [Symptom checklist](https://fixcustomerservice.com/#checks): The signs of a support operation that has outgrown its setup.
- [What it costs](https://fixcustomerservice.com/#cost): Putting a number on slow replies and missed enquiries, including the knock-on effect on reviews and repeat business.
- [How the work runs](https://fixcustomerservice.com/#how): The three stages, what changes at each size of business, and how the options compare.
- [Results](https://fixcustomerservice.com/#proof): Two rebuilds and what measurably changed, including moving 1.5 million cardholders from email queues to a multilingual WhatsApp chatbot.
- [Get in touch](https://fixcustomerservice.com/#talk): Contact form and free 30-minute diagnostic call.
